d: Long, straight chocolate-brown hair with blunt bangs and side-locks frames a youthful face with large, expressive amber eyes. The build is slender with a mature appearance, dressed in a traditional miko-inspired outfit featuring a white wide-sleeved top, a deep navy blue chest panel, and a pleated crimson skirt with a grey and white striped obi. Signature details include brown fingerless gloves with purple wristbands and a large, wooden aircraft-deck-like structure positioned beside the body.
